name: SecuraIQ Canonical Control Registry
description: Cross-framework control registry: each canonical control maps to the real control IDs that genuinely cover it in each of the 14 framework catalogs. Every mapping below was verified by reading each framework's actual control title/keywords -- a framework is omitted from a canonical control's map wherever no real, defensible correspondence exists (never forced to pad coverage). Implementing one canonical control's real-world control (e.g. enabling MFA) is evidence toward every mapped framework control simultaneously.

canonical_controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
canonical_controls.description: Users, and especially privileged/administrative accounts, authenticate with more than one factor.

canonical_controls.name: Encryption of Data at Rest
canonical_controls.description: Sensitive data is encrypted while stored (disk, database, object storage, backups).

canonical_controls.name: Encryption of Data in Transit
canonical_controls.description: Data moving across networks is protected with strong cryptography (TLS or equivalent).

canonical_controls.name: Vulnerability Identification & Remediation
canonical_controls.description: Vulnerabilities are identified through scanning/monitoring and remediated in a timely, risk-based manner.

canonical_controls.name: Asset Inventory
canonical_controls.description: Hardware and software assets are inventoried and tracked.

canonical_controls.name: Backup & Recovery
canonical_controls.description: Data is regularly backed up, backups are protected, and restoration is tested.

canonical_controls.name: Security Logging & Monitoring
canonical_controls.description: Systems generate audit logs, and those logs are centrally collected and reviewed for anomalies.

canonical_controls.name: Incident Response Plan
canonical_controls.description: A documented incident response plan/capability exists and is executed when incidents occur.

canonical_controls.name: Access Control & Least Privilege
canonical_controls.description: Access to systems and data is restricted to authorized users based on need and least privilege.

canonical_controls.name: Security Awareness Training
canonical_controls.description: Personnel receive periodic security awareness and role-based training.

canonical_controls.name: Risk Assessment
canonical_controls.description: Risks (security or privacy) are formally assessed, prioritized, and used to inform decisions.

canonical_controls.name: Third-Party / Supplier Risk Management
canonical_controls.description: Security risk from suppliers and other third parties is assessed and managed through the relationship lifecycle.

canonical_controls.name: Secure Configuration / Hardening
canonical_controls.description: Systems are configured to documented secure baselines rather than insecure defaults.

canonical_controls.name: Network Segmentation & Boundary Protection
canonical_controls.description: Networks are segmented and boundaries are controlled to limit lateral movement and unauthorized access.

canonical_controls.name: Malware / Anti-Malware Protection
canonical_controls.description: Endpoints and systems are protected against malicious code, with detection and response capability.

canonical_controls.name: Penetration Testing
canonical_controls.description: Systems and applications undergo periodic penetration testing / adversarial security testing.

canonical_controls.name: Secure Software Development Lifecycle
canonical_controls.description: Security is integrated into the software development lifecycle (secure coding, review, testing).

canonical_controls.name: Physical Access Control
canonical_controls.description: Physical access to facilities and systems is restricted to authorized personnel and monitored.

canonical_controls.name: Personnel Screening
canonical_controls.description: Personnel are screened (background checks) prior to being granted access to systems or sensitive data.

canonical_controls.name: Termination / Offboarding Access Revocation
canonical_controls.description: Access is promptly revoked when personnel are terminated or change roles.

canonical_controls.name: Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery Planning
canonical_controls.description: A documented plan exists to maintain or restore critical operations during and after a disruption.

canonical_controls.name: Secure Media Disposal / Sanitization
canonical_controls.description: Storage media is securely sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse.
